svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Post: 40 x 40 x 3 mm RHS, 460 mm long. Two 11 mm holes through it,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 25 mm apart, 56 and 81 mm up from its foot, to bolt it to the rail.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: An 18 mm hole through both walls 423 mm up from its foot; weld an

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M16 nut over the hole on the outer face (away from the drum).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Screw: M16 x 200; weld a 16 mm bar 160 mm long across its head as

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a T-handle. A 60 mm rubber pad 15 mm thick on a swivel plate at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: post bolted with 2 x M10 to the outer face of the right side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rail at the middle of the frame. Screwed in, the pad presses on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the drum side between the hoops at the height of the drum axis.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: with the screw tight the drum cannot be turned by hand.
